logo_prompts.concept: 정확한 로스팅 온도와 장인의 정직한 원칙을 표현한 미니멀 수직 기하 심볼
logo_prompts.prompt: Minimal geometric logo symbol featuring three parallel vertical blocks with precise, understated proportions. Flat vector style, using #32383D and #A38E7B on a solid #E2DDD5 background. Centered, simple and unpretentious, no text, no letters, no typography.

logo_prompts.concept: 단단한 내실과 나무의 심재를 닮은 유기적 나이테 곡선
logo_prompts.prompt: An organic line art logo symbol formed by a single continuous line sketching concentric wood grain rings. Flat vector style, using #32383D line on a solid #E2DDD5 background. Centered, understated and subtle, no text, no letters, no typography.

logo_prompts.concept: 로스팅 과정의 온기와 원두의 절제된 형태를 담은 단단한 원형 엠블럼
logo_prompts.prompt: A simple circular emblem badge containing an abstract split-oval silhouette reflecting honest craftsmanship. Flat vector style, using colors #32383D, #A38E7B, and #7A7571 on a solid #E2DDD5 background. Centered, no text, no letters, no typography.
